name: Spiced Chicken & Rice Traybake
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Cut the onions and peppers into chunky wedges and tip them into a large roasting tray with the oil.
Rub the chicken with the paprika, cumin and chilli flakes, sit it on top of the veg and roast for 20 minutes.
Stir the rice into the tray with 600ml boiling water, slice the sweetcorn into rounds and tuck it in, then cover the tray tightly with foil.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked right through. Take the foil off for the last 5 minutes to colour the top.
Serve in the tray with a spoonful of yoghurt on each portion.
